eventMetadata.context_description: Official forecasts from PAGASA indicate Manila's May 24 high will likely reach 34°C under easterly flow, with partly cloudy skies, isolated afternoon thunderstorms, and moderate humidity limiting extreme heat. This aligns with typical late-May conditions before the southwest monsoon strengthens, where daytime maxima average near 34°C but can spike 2–3°C higher with reduced cloud cover or weaker convection. Recent model runs show limited disagreement on steering patterns, though any delay in thunderstorm development could push readings toward 36–37°C, explaining the close market-implied odds between those outcomes. PAGASA's next daily briefing and updated numerical guidance will provide the key data for resolution.
